name: squadsync
description: SquadSync: BGMI team management PWA with last-minute squad notifications

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w worker" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w worker && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint:types: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w worker && npm run typecheck -w client
